title: Happy Memories
setting: A quiet riverbank near a small wooden house.

characters.name: Grandma Rosa
characters.look: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick)

characters.name: Grandpa Joe
characters.look: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan)

sentences.en: Grandma Rosa and Grandpa Joe sit by the river.
sentences.zh: 罗莎奶奶和乔爷爷坐在河边。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) sit together on a bench on the grassy bank of a calm river.

sentences.en: They look at old photos and remember their trip.
sentences.zh: 他们看着旧照片，回忆起那次旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) smile over a small photo album open on their knees by the river; the photos show an elephant and a sunny hot land.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them smiling over old trip photos; remembering itself can't be shown.

sentences.en: During the trip, they rode a big elephant.
sentences.zh: 旅行期间，他们骑过一头大象。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close-up of a photo in the album: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan), a little younger, ride on the back of a big elephant in a hot sunny land.

sentences.en: One day, Grandma Rosa also rode a white horse.
sentences.zh: 有一天，罗莎奶奶还骑了一匹白马。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close-up of a photo in the album: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick), without her walking stick, rides a white horse on a dusty path under a hot sun.

sentences.en: They wore the same straw hats in every photo.
sentences.zh: 每张照片里他们都戴着一样的草帽。
sentences.scene_prompt: Several photos in the open album show Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan), each wearing the same wide straw hat.

sentences.en: Their little house had only one big bed.
sentences.zh: 他们住的小房子里只有一张大床。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close-up of a photo in the album: a small simple room with one big bed, Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) in straw hats laughing beside it.

sentences.en: Grandpa Joe kisses his wife, and they laugh.
sentences.zh: 乔爷爷亲了亲妻子，两人都笑了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) kisses Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) on the cheek and they laugh together by the river at sunset.
